text:
jonathan: heads-up — planning lockfile/vendor bump for release v2.14. Targeting cutoff tomorrow 18:00 UTC. Need quick sanity checks on submodules + any breaking vendor changes. @alex @maria PTAL :eyes:

alex: i'll run a local vendor sync now and post diffs. any preferred merge window? i'd like to land before the cutoff if possible.

maria: i can smoke-test the integration suite after sync. which submodules should I prioritize? vendor/onnx and vendor/proto?

jonathan: exactly — main ones: vendor/onnx vendor/proto vendor/torch-ext. also verify that `scripts/vendorize.py --lock` didn't sneak in functional changes. example command I ran:
```
./scripts/vendorize.py --sync --lock && git add vendor && git commit -m "vendor: sync lockfiles"
```

sam: quick q — do we want a canary branch on staging for this bump? release-captain asked for a short canary run.

release-captain: yes please. create branch `release/v2.14-vendor-sanity` from release-candidate, land the vendor bump there and run e2e + perf smoke. if perf regresses >5% we abort and investigate.

ci-bot: CI pipeline queued for branch release/v2.14-vendor-sanity — 12 jobs.

alex: pushed a WIP PR with vendor diffs (link: https://git.internal/redwood/pulls/xxxx). changed 3 files in vendor/onnx and updated vendor.lock. no API surface changes expected.

maria: ran integration smoke locally, seeing a proto gen mismatch in the toolchain. diff shows `PROTO_VERSION=3.20` bumped to `3.21` in the vendor tree. i'll open a quick patch to pin the generator.

jonathan: thanks — if the generator pin is safe, we can land it. sam, can you ack the patch? otherwise i'll pin generator in CI/build until we have time to update consumers.

sam: can review in ~30m. also suggesting we run `make -j` on staging GPU nodes to catch any binary/flag issues earlier.

alex: added a note to the PR to add `-fPIC` in vendor/torch-ext build flags where required; will push a small fix if builds fail.

release-captain: timeline reminder: target merge to the release branch at least 1 hour before cutoff to give SRE a deploy window. if you hit a blocker, call it out here and ping infra oncall.

maria: filing the proto-gen patch now, PR incoming.

jonathan: please annotate these PRs with the label `release-v2.14` and include a short changelog bullet in the PR description called out as "vendor/lockfile: x -> y". makes release notes easier. thanks!

ci-bot: PR #3456 created by maria: "build(proto): pin gen to 3.20 to avoid mismatch" — CI started.

sam: :thumbsup: will run staging builds after PR merges and report back.
